subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should the repository accept these CodeQL and stale action revisions after confirming current-main state and reviewing redacted live workflow output?
rationale: The patch is mechanically small, but it changes third-party automation behavior and no contributor-provided runtime proof establishes the upgraded workflows' observed behavior.

options.title: Review and merge with live evidence

options.title: Hold for a newer dependency batch
